SELECT DISTINCT
    "e"."name" AS "event_space_name",
    "e"."event_space" AS "event_space_type",
    "e"."capacity"
FROM
    "eventspaces" "e"
WHERE
    "e"."event_space" IN ('Banquet Hall', 'Conference Room')
    AND CAST("e"."capacity" AS INTEGER) >= 200;

    "contactinfo"

    "event_space" IN ('Banquet Hall', 'Conference Room')
    AND CAST("capacity" AS INTEGER) = 200;

SELECT DISTINCT
    r."id",
    r."name",
    r."address",
    r."food_service",
    r."cuisine"
FROM
    "restaurants" r
WHERE
    r."food_service" = 'Café' AND r."cuisine" = 'Italian'

UNION ALL

SELECT
    r."id",
    r."name",
    r."address",
    r."food_service",
    r."cuisine"
FROM
    "restaurants" r
WHERE
    r."food_service" != 'Café' OR r."cuisine" != 'Italian';

    s."language"
FROM

SELECT s."name" AS chef_name,
       s."language" AS chef_language
FROM "staff" s
WHERE s."role" = 'Chef'
  AND TRIM(LOWER(s."language")) = 'english'

UNION ALL


SELECT s."name" AS server_name,
       s."language" AS server_language
FROM "staff" s
WHERE s."role" = 'Server'
  AND TRIM(LOWER(s."language")) IN (
      SELECT DISTINCT TRIM(LOWER(s2."language"))
      FROM "staff" s2
      WHERE s2."role" = 'Chef'
  );

SELECT
    its."id" AS specialist_id,
    its."name" AS specialist_name,
    STRING_AGG(s."system_name", ', ' ORDER BY s."system_name") AS systems
FROM
    "it_support_specialists" its
LEFT JOIN
    "it_support_specialists_systems" itss ON its."id" = itss."it_specialist_id"::BIGINT
LEFT JOIN
    "systems" s ON itss."system_id"::BIGINT = s."system_id"::BIGINT
GROUP BY
    its."id", its."name"
ORDER BY
    its."name";
110:
SELECT
    its."id" AS specialist_id,
    its."name" AS specialist_name,
    s."system_name",
    s."is_active"::BOOLEAN AS is_active
FROM
    "it_support_specialists" its
CROSS JOIN
    "systems" s
LEFT JOIN
    "it_support_specialists_systems" itss ON its."id" = itss."it_specialist_id"
                                          AND s."system_id" = itss."system_id"
ORDER BY
    its."id",
    s."system_name";
111:
SELECT
    its."name" AS it_specialist_name,
    s."system_name",
    s."is_active"::BOOLEAN AS is_active
FROM
    "it_support_specialists" its
JOIN
    "it_support_specialists_systems" itss ON its."id" = itss."it_specialist_id"
JOIN
    "systems" s ON itss."system_id" = s."system_id"
ORDER BY
    its."name", s."system_name";

WITH responsibility_counts AS (
    SELECT
        r."responsibility",
        COUNT(DISTINCT ir."internshipid") AS internship_count
    FROM
        "responsibilities" r
    JOIN
        "internships_responsibilities" ir ON r."id" = ir."responsibilityid"
    GROUP BY
        r."responsibility"
),
total_internships AS (
    SELECT
        COUNT(DISTINCT "id") AS total
    FROM
        "internships"
)
SELECT
    rc."responsibility"
FROM
    responsibility_counts rc
CROSS JOIN
    total_internships ti
WHERE
    rc.internship_count = ti.total;

    i."id" AS internship_id,
    i."title" AS internship_title,
    r."id" AS responsibility_id,
    r."responsibility" AS responsibility_name
FROM

JOIN
    "responsibilities" r ON ir."responsibilityid" = r."id";

    "minimum_years",
    "preferred_years"
FROM
    "jobs"
WHERE
    "salary" = (SELECT MAX(CAST("salary" AS REAL)) FROM "jobs");

SELECT
    p."title" AS position_title,
    sd."salary_range" AS compensation_range,
    sd."hourly_rate" AS hourly_rate
FROM
    "position" p
JOIN
    "salarydetails" sd ON p."id" = sd."positionid"
WHERE
    LOWER(p."title") = 'software developer';
263:

    "salarydetails"."hourly_rate" 
FROM
    "salarydetails"
JOIN
    "position" ON "salarydetails"."positionid" = "position"."id"
WHERE
    LOWER("position"."title") = LOWER('Software Developer');

265:
SELECT j."preferred_years"
FROM "jobs" j
WHERE j."salary" = (
    SELECT MAX(CAST(j2."salary" AS REAL))
    FROM "jobs" j2
    WHERE j2."salary" ~ '^[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?$'
);
266:
WITH max_salary_job AS (
    SELECT
        "jobid",
        "minimum_years"::BIGINT AS min_exp,
        "preferred_years"::BIGINT AS pref_exp,
        "salary"::REAL AS salary
    FROM
        "jobs"
    ORDER BY
        "salary"::REAL DESC
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT
    j."jobtitle",
    msj.min_exp AS minimum_required_experience_years,
    msj.pref_exp AS preferred_experience_years,
    j."description"
FROM
    max_salary_job msj
JOIN
    "jobs" j ON msj."jobid" = j."jobid";
